unread_trigger_facts.partnership_taxable_year: 411(f)'s 'ends within, and not with' condition chooses between 411(f) and the ordinary partner-year rule for the share through the death month; both include it and neither includes the later share, so the consequence does not depend on it (parameter trigger)
unread_trigger_facts.taxable_year: the deceased partner's final taxable year, which 411(f) and the partner-year sentence compare with the partnership year; consequence-neutral (see partnership_taxable_year)

when.partnership_status: in computing the deceased partner's own net earnings: the part of his distributive share of the partnership's ordinary income or loss (including the share of his estate or of any other person succeeding, by reason of his death, to rights with respect to his partnership interest) attributable to an interest in the partnership during any period beginning on or after the first day of the first calendar month following the month in which he died

cases.description: 411(f) includes in the final-year computation only the share "as is not attributable to an interest in the partnership during any period beginning on or after the first day of the first calendar month following the month in which such partner died", and 411(a)'s partner-year sentence only a partnership year "ending within or with his taxable year", a year that ends at his death. This part meets neither, whichever rule includes the earlier share, so it is not the deceased partner's net earnings; 411(f)(2) counts the share of his estate or successor as his distributive share.

residual_default.description: No case holds: 411(f) adds the deceased partner's allocated share through the month of death to the final-year computation; otherwise the ordinary partnership rules apply.
